platform.name: Algonquian Real Estate Platform
platform.production_policy: Canonical source may be promoted to main after code review and static validation, but no plugin may be described as live-production ready until its WordPress installation, migration, permissions, security and end-to-end acceptance gates are recorded as passed.

plugins.name: Algonquian Real Estate Platform Plugin
plugins.authority: Shared bootstrap, registry, capabilities, security, mail, audit, file storage, health monitoring, page generation and common UI

plugins.name: Algonquian Navigation
plugins.authority: Public enterprise header and footer navigation, responsive menu presentation, utility actions and routing schema without operational record authority

plugins.name: Algonquian Pipeline CRM
plugins.authority: Canonical deal records, acquisition stages, Kanban board, notes, tasks, assignments, activity history and closing status

plugins.name: Algonquian Deal Intake
plugins.authority: Seller leads, property submissions, consent records, attachments, duplicate detection and controlled initial deal creation

plugins.name: Algonquian MAO Engine
plugins.authority: Versioned underwriting scenarios, formulas, assumptions, outputs, risk flags and approvals

plugins.name: Algonquian Document Library
plugins.authority: Document metadata, categories, versions, access classification, retention, legal hold and packages

plugins.name: Algonquian PDF & Signature Engine
plugins.authority: PDF rendering, signature requests, signer routing, provider events and executed-file references

plugins.name: Algonquian Offer Generator
plugins.authority: Offer records, templates, merge fields, approval workflow, versions and delivery status

plugins.name: Algonquian Automation Engine
plugins.authority: Automation rules, triggers, conditions, actions, queues, retries, failure handling and execution history

plugins.name: Algonquian Admin Command Center
plugins.authority: Executive dashboard, KPIs, reports, system health, alerts, audit visibility and authorized administrative commands

plugins.name: Algonquian Buyer Portal
plugins.authority: Buyer registration, protected deal access, NDA gating, downloads, criteria and interest submissions

plugins.name: Algonquian Deal Marketplace
plugins.authority: Controlled opportunity publication, buyer visibility, access rules and marketplace responses

plugins.name: Algonquian Funding Tracker
plugins.authority: Capital-source relationships, funding commitments, deal-level funding status and administrative funding activity

plugins.name: Algonquian Digital Products
plugins.authority: Governed digital product catalog records and commerce linkage

plugins.name: Algonquian Digital Store
plugins.authority: WooCommerce-backed digital catalog, authenticated product vault and checkout handoff

plugins.name: Algonquian WooCommerce Bridge
plugins.authority: WooCommerce entitlement, order, refund, subscription, revenue and dashboard integration without duplicating WooCommerce records

plugins.name: Algonquian Property Stewardship Services
plugins.authority: Owner-authorized stewardship clients, property visits, vendor coordination, reports and client portal access

release_requirements.production_gate: No package may be described as production-ready until installation, activation, upgrade, permissions, security, database, page-generation and end-to-end workflow checks pass.
release_requirements.agent_boundary: AI agents may research, enrich, classify, calculate, draft, prioritize, schedule, monitor and execute approved administrative workflows; final acquisition strategy, binding offers, contracts, capital commitments, funds movement and closing authority remain human-controlled.
